Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities,

timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS $3199 -1965 

Indian Standard 

DEFINITION OF SIDE 

(LEFT OR RIGHT) OF WEAVING 

PREPARATORY MACHINES AND 

WEAVING LOOMS 

0. FOREWORD 

Oa This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institu- 
tion on 20 July 1965, after the draft finalized by the Cotton Weaving 
Machinery Components Sectional Committee had been approved by the 
Textile Division Council. 

0,2 This standard has been prepared with the intention of eliminating 
ambiguity and confusion arising from local interpretations of the definition 
of side ( left or right ) of weaving preparatory machines and weaving 
looms employed in the textile mills. 

0.3 In the formulation of this standard, due consideration has been given 
to international co-ordination am.ong the standards and practices prevail- 
ing in different countries in addition to relating it to the practice followed 
in the field in this country. This has been met by basing this standard on 
the following recommendations issued by the International Organization 
for Standardization: 

ISO Recommendation 108 Weaving looms definition of side ( left or 

right ) 
ISO Recommendation 141 Pirn winders and cross winders definition 

of side ( left or right ) 
ISO Recommendation M2 Weaving preparatory machines defiriition 

of side ( left or right ) 



1. SCOPE 

1,1 This standard prescribes the definition of side ( left or right ) of weav- 
ing preparatory machines and weaving looms. 

2. DEFINITION OF SIDE (LEFT OR RIGHT) 

2.1 Pirn Winders and Cross Winders 

2.1.1 Single-Sided Machines — For the determination of the side of a single 
sided machine, the observer shall look from the position of the operator 

3 



IS : 3199 - 1965 



towards the machine ( ^^^ Fig. 1 ). When the observer looks from this 
position, the side on his left shall be the left-hand side and that on his right 
shall be the right-hand side of the machine. 

DRIVE- 



LH SIDE 




RH SIDE 



POSITION OF OBSERVER 

Fig. 1 Side of Single-Sided Machine 

2.1.2 Double-Sided Machines with Lateral Drive — For the determination of 
side of the double sided machines with lateral drive, the observer shall look 
from the drive towards the farther end of the frame {see Fig. 2 ). When 
the observer looks from this position, the side on his left shall be the left- 
hand side and that on his right shall be the right-hand side of the machine.

Fig, 2 Side of Double-Sided Machine with Lateral Drive 

2.1.3 Double-Sided Machines with Centre Drive — For the determination of 
the side of the double-sided machine with centre drive, for each side of the 
machine the observer shall look from the drive towards the farther ends of 
the frame (see Fig. 3). When the observer looks from this position, the 
side on his left shall be the left-hand side and that on his right shall be the 
right-hand side of the machine.

IS : 3199 - 1965 

2.2 Weaving Preparatory Machines 

2.2.1 For the determination of the side of weaving preparatory machines, 
the observer shall look against the flow of the material {see Fig. 4, 5 
and 6 ). When the observer looks from this position, the side on his left 
shall be the left-hand side and that on his right shall be the right-hand side 
of the machine. 

Examples^ 

a) Warping machine {see Fig. 4 ), 

b) Sectional warping and beaming machine {see Fig. 5 ), and 

c) Warp sizing machine ( see Fig, 6 ). 

2.3 Weaving Looms — For the determination of the side of loom, the 
view shall be taken against the run of the warp ( see Fig. 7). When the 
observer looks from this position, the side on his left shall be the left-hand 
side and that on his right shall be the right-hand side of the loom.
